title: Production project capacity authority and manual ingress contract

conditions.description: Reconcile and provide an integrated production contract for manual browser ingress: default-off project enforcement configuration, authoritative complete all-role occupancy and versioned policy at the same project ledger snapshot, trusted target/role identity, atomic reservation and original send/no-send lifecycle with uncertain-effect fencing, and explicit safe caller API. Main 5446b1497656c4da8fcd7267bfaf7f5e5a0e091a only exposes disposable ProjectCapacityAdmission; its fixture cannot establish production occupancy. Identify required cross-owned changes and source/review provenance, then reissue scope if needed.
